newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-ENGLISH RFU APPROVES FIVE NATIONS DEAL.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-ENGLISH RFU APPROVES FIVE NATIONS DEAL.

text.p: The English Rugby Football Union (RFU) on Friday formally approved a television deal which preserved England's Five Nations status.
Cliff Brittle, chairman of the RFU executive committee, brokered the last-ditch deal with Wales, Scotland and Ireland which staved off England's expulsion from the championship.
On Friday he persuaded the RFU committee members to ratify the agreement, which is still subject to debate by the Five Nations committee in Dublin on Monday.
